title: The Arrivals
logline: Continuum no importa franquicias. Importa personas.
description: The flagship personal project developed inside Continuum. It is developed manga-first: approved story structure becomes a draft, a panel script, rough and final manga, and only then an anime adaptation.
_note: This manifest is the explicit registry of the project's documents. Lifecycle values transcribe the standing each document's author recorded in its own Status line; changing a lifecycle here is how a document is approved, locked or superseded. A Markdown file matched by 'discover' but not listed below appears as unfiled and is never treated as approved.

documents.title: S1E1 — Not This Time · Story structure
documents.summary: The approved scene-card structure for the opening episode: sixteen scenes in their accepted dramatic sequence. Page count, runtime, panel and shot counts and final lines are not locked.

documents.title: S1E1 — Not This Time · Draft 1
documents.summary: Draft 1, derived from the approved scene-card structure, was approved after human Story Room review with no content revisions. It is now the approved story draft feeding the Manga Panel Script.

documents.title: S1E1 — Not This Time · Manga Panel Script
documents.summary: Approved panel script: 16 approved scenes across 79 provisional pages in three chapter cuts. Page and panel counts stay adjustable only during rough visual review. Next gate: rough manga.

documents.title: Opening Groups
documents.summary: Opening-season arrival structure, Group 1 and arrival-state rules.

documents.title: Opening Group 2
documents.summary: Group 2 composition, the opening hook and cross-world language behaviour.

documents.title: Group 3 Direction
documents.summary: Group 3 composition, late-season introduction and convergence. Scene-level execution remains open.

documents.title: Main Story Spine
documents.summary: Broad Season 1–3 narrative spine and escalation logic. High-confidence direction; expandable, not scene-locked.

documents.title: Creative Direction
documents.summary: Consolidated creative direction. Concept-level canon only where explicitly marked inside.

documents.summary: How approved story structure becomes manga, then anime, without skipping validation gates.
